scene_type: 2D (top-down view of a living room; floor plane faces the camera)
units: pixels (x right, y down) and seconds; no metric scale

camera.motion: static (frame differencing shows change only on the robot path and its reflection in the glass table; no global shift)
camera.view: overhead, looking straight down at the floor; slight perspective: left/right/top walls visible as inner faces, so tall objects (lamp shade, glass side table top, sofa top) look slightly larger/displaced versus floor-level ones. Floor-level objects (robot, dock, rug) are all at about the same depth -> one px scale valid for the robot's motion on the floor.

robot_vacuum.description: white round robot vacuum cleaner, the only moving object; starts docked at the charging dock on the right wall, drives left (slightly upward) past the lamp, turns gently and drives left-down, stops near the sofa's left arm
robot_vacuum.reference_point: centre of a robust circle fit to the mask contour (columns x, y); for a disc this is its origin

size_px.note: length = width = ~118-119 px (circular, top view); height not observable from overhead

events.event: robot starts moving (leaves dock), speeding up
events.note: step 0->1 is ~0.5 px (noise level, dock overlap), 1->2 is 1.7 px; take motion start as frame 1 (+-1)

events.event: robot passes just below floor lamp / TV console (closest approach, mask top edge y~297, lamp shade bottom y~300)
direction change: heading turns from up-left (~173 deg) to down-left; topmost point of path (min y = 355.85)
local speed minimum ~15.3 px/frame during the turn

events.note: last real step frame 68->69 = 0.9 px; frames 69-79 stationary at (650.1, 500.2)

charging_dock.desc: small white dock on the right wall (two white blocks), robot's start

floor_lamp.desc: white pleated round lamp shade with dark centre/bulb, at right end of TV console
floor_lamp.note: elevated -> appears larger than at floor level

tv_console.desc: dark grey low media console along top wall
tv_console.note: right end hidden under lamp shade; dark shadow above it up to y~100

white_vase.desc: small white patterned vase/pot on left end of the TV console

glass_side_table.desc: transparent glass table with light wooden frame, top-right corner; shows a reflection of the robot frames ~13-26
glass_side_table.note: seen obliquely (tall object near image edge) - extents unreliable

sofa.desc: large cream curved (crescent) sofa, bottom centre, with two grey-blue cushions

cushion_left.desc: grey-blue pillow on left part of sofa

cushion_right.desc: grey-blue pillow on right part of sofa

round_fur_rug.desc: round white fluffy fur rug / pouf, bottom-left, partly under sofa's left arm

walls.desc: white walls left, top, right (inner faces visible due to perspective)

static_auto_measure: static_auto.json (threshold boxes at frame 79; only wood_slat_bench and white_vase are trustworthy there)
